intro.text: Good morning, team — big day today: Al-Jadda wants goods for the Ramadan exhibition, and the supplier is delivering a new batch. Everyone handle your part on the system, and if anything stops you, say so right away
Sure, I'll start with Al-Jadda's quotation as soon as they call
The warehouse is ready, I'll receive the supplier's batch and prepare Al-Jadda's order
